extension.name: plg_content_fechome
extension.author: FreeExtraChips
extension.description:
FEC Home Shortcodes

Replaces {fec-*} shortcodes on the homepage Joomla article with the rendered output of helpers defined in components/com_bonuses/helpers/fec_common_lib.php.

Supported shortcodes (place inside the home article body):

  • {fec-home-hero} — Hero section (h1, stats, CTAs)
  • {fec-trust-pulse} — 7-day activity strip
  • {fec-browse-grid} — Browse by bonus type (6 cards, country-aware)
  • {fec-editor-picks} — 3 verified bonus picks
  • {fec-latest-bonuses} — 6 newest bonuses (country-aware)
  • {fec-blog-grid} — 3 latest blog posts from EasyBlog
  • {fec-latest-casinos} — 4 latest casino reviews

By default the plugin only fires on the article with alias home. Change the alias or enable for all articles in the params below.

field.name: home_alias
field.label: Home article alias
field.description: Only process articles with this alias (case-sensitive). Default: home

field.name: enabled_for_all
field.label: Process all articles
field.description: If Yes, scans every com_content article for shortcodes. Otherwise only the article matching the alias above. Recommended: No.
